comment: This is the ARIA label for a git diff header.
A git diff header looks like this: @@ -154,12 +159,39 @@.
That encodes that at original line 154 (which is now line 159), 12 lines were removed/changed with 39 lines.
Variables 0 and 1 refer to the diff index out of total number of diffs.
Variables 2 and 4 will be numbers (a line number).
Variables 3 and 5 will be "no lines changed", "1 line changed" or "X lines changed", localized separately.
The placeholders are contents of the line and should not be translated.

accessibilitySupport.off.en: Assume a screen reader is not attached.

accessibilitySupport.on.en: Optimize for usage with a Screen Reader.

allowVariableFonts.en: Controls whether to allow using variable fonts in the editor.

copyWithSyntaxHighlighting.en: Controls whether syntax highlighting should be copied into the clipboard.

fontWeightErrorMessage.en: Only "normal" and "bold" keywords or numbers between 1 and 1000 are allowed.

glyphMargin.en: Controls whether the editor should render the vertical glyph margin. Glyph margin is mostly used for debugging.

hideCursorInOverviewRuler.en: Controls whether the cursor should be hidden in the overview ruler.

hover.above.en: Prefer showing hovers above the line, if there's space.

hover.delay.en: Controls the delay in milliseconds after which the hover is shown.

hover.enabled.en: Controls whether the hover is shown.

hover.enabled.onKeyboardModifier.en: Hover is shown when holding `{0}` or `Alt` (the opposite modifier of `#editor.multiCursorModifier#`)

hover.hidingDelay.en: Controls the delay in milliseconds after which the hover is hidden. Requires `#editor.hover.sticky#` to be enabled.

hover.showLongLineWarning.en: Controls whether long line warning hovers are shown, such as when tokenization is skipped or rendering is paused.

hover.sticky.en: Controls whether the hover should remain visible when mouse is moved over it.

inlayHints.padding.en: Enables the padding around the inlay hints in the editor.

inlineSuggest.edits.renderSideBySide.en: Controls whether larger suggestions can be shown side by side.

inlineSuggest.edits.showCollapsed.en: Controls whether the suggestion will show as collapsed until jumping to it.

inlineSuggest.minShowDelay.en: Controls the minimal delay in milliseconds after which inline suggestions are shown after typing.

inlineSuggest.showToolbar.never.en: Never show the inline suggestion toolbar.

inlineSuggest.showToolbar.onHover.en: Show the inline suggestion toolbar when hovering over an inline suggestion.

inlineSuggest.suppressInlineSuggestions.en: Suppresses inline completions for specified extension IDs -- comma separated.

inlineSuggest.suppressInSnippetMode.en: Controls whether inline suggestions are suppressed when in snippet mode.

inlineSuggest.suppressSuggestions.en: Controls how inline suggestions interact with the suggest widget. If enabled, the suggest widget is not shown automatically when inline suggestions are available.

inlineSuggest.syntaxHighlightingEnabled.en: Controls whether to show syntax highlighting for inline suggestions in the editor.

inlineSuggest.triggerCommandOnProviderCh.en: Controls whether to trigger a command when the inline suggestion provider changes.

letterSpacing.en: Controls the letter spacing in pixels.

lineHeight.en:
Controls the line height. 
 - Use 0 to automatically compute the line height from the font size.
 - Values between 0 and 8 will be used as a multiplier with the font size.
 - Values greater than or equal to 8 will be used as effective values.

lineNumbers.en: Controls the display of line numbers.

lineNumbers.interval.en: Line numbers are rendered every 10 lines.

lineNumbers.on.en: Line numbers are rendered as absolute number.

lineNumbers.relative.en: Line numbers are rendered as distance in lines to cursor position.

linkedEditing.en: Controls whether the editor has linked editing enabled. Depending on the language, related symbols such as HTML tags, are updated while editing.

links.en: Controls whether the editor should detect links and make them clickable.

minimap.autohide.en: Controls whether the minimap is hidden automatically.

minimap.autohide.mouseover.en: The minimap is hidden when mouse is not over the minimap and shown when mouse is over the minimap.

minimap.autohide.scroll.en: The minimap is only shown when the editor is scrolled

minimap.enabled.en: Controls whether the minimap is shown.

minimap.markSectionHeaderRegex.en: Defines the regular expression used to find section headers in comments. The regex must contain a named match group `label` (written as `(?<label>.+)`) that encapsulates the section header, otherwise it will not work. Optionally you can include another match group named `separator`. Use \n in the pattern to match multi-line headers.

minimap.maxColumn.en: Limit the width of the minimap to render at most a certain number of columns.

minimap.renderCharacters.en: Render the actual characters on a line as opposed to color blocks.

minimap.scale.en: Scale of content drawn in the minimap: 1, 2 or 3.

minimap.sectionHeaderFontSize.en: Controls the font size of section headers in the minimap.

minimap.sectionHeaderLetterSpacing.en: Controls the amount of space (in pixels) between characters of section header. This helps the readability of the header in small font sizes.

minimap.showMarkSectionHeaders.en: Controls whether MARK: comments are shown as section headers in the minimap.

minimap.showRegionSectionHeaders.en: Controls whether named regions are shown as section headers in the minimap.

minimap.showSlider.en: Controls when the minimap slider is shown.

minimap.side.en: Controls the side where to render the minimap.

minimap.size.en: Controls the size of the minimap.

minimap.size.fill.en: The minimap will stretch or shrink as necessary to fill the height of the editor (no scrolling).

minimap.size.fit.en: The minimap will shrink as necessary to never be larger than the editor (no scrolling).

minimap.size.proportional.en: The minimap has the same size as the editor contents (and might scroll).

mouseMiddleClickAction.en: Controls what happens when middle mouse button is clicked in the editor.

mouseWheelScrollSensitivity.en: A multiplier to be used on the `deltaX` and `deltaY` of mouse wheel scroll events.

mouseWheelZoom.en: Zoom the font of the editor when using mouse wheel and holding `Ctrl`.

mouseWheelZoom.mac.en: Zoom the font of the editor when using mouse wheel and holding `Cmd`.

multiCursorLimit.en: Controls the max number of cursors that can be in an active editor at once.

multiCursorMergeOverlapping.en: Merge multiple cursors when they are overlapping.

multiCursorModifier.en: The modifier to be used to add multiple cursors with the mouse. The Go to Definition and Open Link mouse gestures will adapt such that they do not conflict with the [multicursor modifier](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/codebasics#_multicursor-modifier).
comment: - `ctrlCmd` refers to a value the setting can take and should not be localized.
- `Control` and `Command` refer to the modifier keys Ctrl or Cmd on the keyboard and can be localized.

multiCursorModifier.alt.en: Maps to `Alt` on Windows and Linux and to `Option` on macOS.

multiCursorModifier.ctrlCmd.en: Maps to `Control` on Windows and Linux and to `Command` on macOS.

multiCursorPaste.en: Controls pasting when the line count of the pasted text matches the cursor count.

multiCursorPaste.full.en: Each cursor pastes the full text.

multiCursorPaste.spread.en: Each cursor pastes a single line of the text.

occurrencesHighlight.en: Controls whether occurrences should be highlighted across open files.

occurrencesHighlight.multiFile.en: Experimental: Highlights occurrences across all valid open files.

occurrencesHighlight.singleFile.en: Highlights occurrences only in the current file.

occurrencesHighlightDelay.en: Controls the delay in milliseconds after which occurrences are highlighted.

offWhenInlineCompletions.en: Quick suggestions are disabled when inline completions are showing

on.en: Quick suggestions show inside the suggest widget

overtypeCursorStyle.en: Controls the cursor style in overtype input mode.

overviewRulerBorder.en: Controls whether a border should be drawn around the overview ruler.

padding.bottom.en: Controls the amount of space between the bottom edge of the editor and the last line.

padding.top.en: Controls the amount of space between the top edge of the editor and the first line.

parameterHints.cycle.en: Controls whether the parameter hints menu cycles or closes when reaching the end of the list.

parameterHints.enabled.en: Enables a pop-up that shows parameter documentation and type information as you type.

pasteAs.enabled.en: Controls whether you can paste content in different ways.

pasteAs.showPasteSelector.en: Controls if a widget is shown when pasting content in to the editor. This widget lets you control how the file is pasted.

pasteAs.showPasteSelector.afterPaste.en: Show the paste selector widget after content is pasted into the editor.

pasteAs.showPasteSelector.never.en: Never show the paste selector widget. Instead the default pasting behavior is always used.

peekWidgetDefaultFocus.en: Controls whether to focus the inline editor or the tree in the peek widget.

peekWidgetDefaultFocus.editor.en: Focus the editor when opening peek

peekWidgetDefaultFocus.tree.en: Focus the tree when opening peek

quickSuggestions.en: Controls whether suggestions should automatically show up while typing. This can be controlled for typing in comments, strings, and other code. Quick suggestion can be configured to show as ghost text or with the suggest widget. Also be aware of the {0}-setting which controls if suggestions are triggered by special characters.

quickSuggestions.other.en: Enable quick suggestions outside of strings and comments.

quickSuggestions.topLevel.inline.en: Quick suggestions show as ghost text for all token types

quickSuggestions.topLevel.off.en: Quick suggestions are disabled for all token types

quickSuggestions.topLevel.offWhenInlineC.en: Quick suggestions are disabled for all token types when inline completions are showing

quickSuggestions.topLevel.on.en: Quick suggestions are enabled for all token types

quickSuggestionsDelay.en: Controls the delay in milliseconds after which quick suggestions will show up.

renameOnType.en: Controls whether the editor auto renames on type.

renderControlCharacters.en: Controls whether the editor should render control characters.

renderFinalNewline.en: Render last line number when the file ends with a newline.

renderLineHighlight.en: Controls how the editor should render the current line highlight.

renderLineHighlight.all.en: Highlights both the gutter and the current line.

renderLineHighlightOnlyWhenFocus.en: Controls if the editor should render the current line highlight only when the editor is focused.

renderRichScreenReaderContent.en: Whether to render rich screen reader content when the `#editor.editContext#` setting is enabled.

renderWhitespace.en: Controls how the editor should render whitespace characters.

renderWhitespace.boundary.en: Render whitespace characters except for single spaces between words.

renderWhitespace.selection.en: Render whitespace characters only on selected text.

roundedSelection.en: Controls whether selections should have rounded corners.

rulers.en: Render vertical rulers after a certain number of monospace characters. Use multiple values for multiple rulers. No rulers are drawn if array is empty.

rulers.size.en: Number of monospace characters at which this editor ruler will render.

screenReaderAnnounceInlineSuggestion.en: Control whether inline suggestions are announced by a screen reader.

scrollbar.horizontal.en: Controls the visibility of the horizontal scrollbar.

scrollbar.horizontal.auto.en: The horizontal scrollbar will be visible only when necessary.

scrollbar.horizontal.fit.en: The horizontal scrollbar will always be hidden.

scrollbar.horizontal.visible.en: The horizontal scrollbar will always be visible.

scrollbar.horizontalScrollbarSize.en: The height of the horizontal scrollbar.

scrollbar.ignoreHorizontalScrollbarInCon.en: When set, the horizontal scrollbar will not increase the size of the editor's content.

scrollbar.scrollByPage.en: Controls whether clicks scroll by page or jump to click position.

scrollbar.vertical.en: Controls the visibility of the vertical scrollbar.

scrollbar.vertical.auto.en: The vertical scrollbar will be visible only when necessary.

scrollbar.vertical.fit.en: The vertical scrollbar will always be hidden.

scrollbar.vertical.visible.en: The vertical scrollbar will always be visible.

scrollbar.verticalScrollbarSize.en: The width of the vertical scrollbar.

scrollBeyondLastColumn.en: Controls the number of extra characters beyond which the editor will scroll horizontally.

scrollBeyondLastLine.en: Controls whether the editor will scroll beyond the last line.

scrollOnMiddleClick.en: Controls whether the editor will scroll when the middle button is pressed.

scrollPredominantAxis.en: Scroll only along the predominant axis when scrolling both vertically and horizontally at the same time. Prevents horizontal drift when scrolling vertically on a trackpad.

selectedTextMatchMode.en: Controls how occurrences of selected text are matched when selecting the next, previous, or all occurrences and when highlighting selection matches. `caseSensitive` and `caseInsensitive` match substrings independently of the Find widget. An empty selection always starts a whole-word, case-sensitive search.

selectedTextMatchMode.caseInsensitive.en: Match occurrences case-insensitively and independently of the Find widget.

selectedTextMatchMode.caseSensitive.en: Match occurrences case-sensitively and independently of the Find widget.

selectedTextMatchMode.findOptions.en: Use the Find widget's match case and whole word settings.

selectionClipboard.en: Controls whether the Linux primary clipboard should be supported.

selectionHighlight.en: Controls whether the editor should highlight matches similar to the selection.

selectionHighlightMaxLength.en: Controls how many characters can be in the selection before similar matches are not highlighted. Set to zero for unlimited.

selectionHighlightMultiline.en: Controls whether the editor should highlight selection matches that span multiple lines.

selectLeadingAndTrailingWhitespace.en: Whether leading and trailing whitespace should always be selected.

selectSubwords.en: Whether subwords (like 'foo' in 'fooBar' or 'foo_bar') should be selected.

showFoldingControls.en: Controls when the folding controls on the gutter are shown.

showFoldingControls.mouseover.en: Only show the folding controls when the mouse is over the gutter.

showFoldingControls.never.en: Never show the folding controls and reduce the gutter size.

showUnused.en: Controls fading out of unused code.

smoothScrolling.en: Controls whether the editor will scroll using an animation.

snippetSuggestions.en: Controls whether snippets are shown with other suggestions and how they are sorted.

snippetSuggestions.bottom.en: Show snippet suggestions below other suggestions.

snippetSuggestions.inline.en: Show snippets suggestions with other suggestions.

snippetSuggestions.top.en: Show snippet suggestions on top of other suggestions.

stickyTabStops.en: Emulate selection behavior of tab characters when using spaces for indentation. Selection will stick to tab stops.

suggest.filterGraceful.en: Controls whether filtering and sorting suggestions accounts for small typos.

suggest.insertMode.en: Controls whether words are overwritten when accepting completions. Note that this depends on extensions opting into this feature.

suggest.insertMode.always.en: Always select a suggestion when automatically triggering IntelliSense.

suggest.insertMode.insert.en: Insert suggestion without overwriting text right of the cursor.

suggest.insertMode.never.en: Never select a suggestion when automatically triggering IntelliSense.

suggest.insertMode.replace.en: Insert suggestion and overwrite text right of the cursor.

suggest.insertMode.whenQuickSuggestion.en: Select a suggestion only when triggering IntelliSense as you type.

suggest.insertMode.whenTriggerCharacter.en: Select a suggestion only when triggering IntelliSense from a trigger character.

suggest.localityBonus.en: Controls whether sorting favors words that appear close to the cursor.

suggest.preview.en: Controls whether to preview the suggestion outcome in the editor.

suggest.selectionMode.en: Controls whether a suggestion is selected when the widget shows. Note that this only applies to automatically triggered suggestions ({0} and {1}) and that a suggestion is always selected when explicitly invoked, e.g via `Ctrl+Space`.

suggest.shareSuggestSelections.en: Controls whether remembered suggestion selections are shared between multiple workspaces and windows (needs `#editor.suggestSelection#`).

suggest.showIcons.en: Controls whether to show or hide icons in suggestions.

suggest.showInlineDetails.en: Controls whether suggest details show inline with the label or only in the details widget.

suggest.showStatusBar.en: Controls the visibility of the status bar at the bottom of the suggest widget.

suggest.snippetsPreventQuickSuggestions.en: Controls whether an active snippet prevents quick suggestions.

suggestFontSize.en: Font size for the suggest widget. When set to {0}, the value of {1} is used.

suggestLineHeight.en: Line height for the suggest widget. When set to {0}, the value of {1} is used. The minimum value is 8.

suggestOnTriggerCharacters.en: Controls whether suggestions should automatically show up when typing trigger characters.

suggestSelection.en: Controls how suggestions are pre-selected when showing the suggest list.

suggestSelection.recentlyUsed.en: Select recent suggestions unless further typing selects one, e.g. `console.| -> console.log` because `log` has been completed recently.

suggestSelection.recentlyUsedByPrefix.en: Select suggestions based on previous prefixes that have completed those suggestions, e.g. `co -> console` and `con -> const`.

tabCompletion.on.en: Tab complete will insert the best matching suggestion when pressing tab.

tabCompletion.onlySnippets.en: Tab complete snippets when their prefix match. Works best when 'quickSuggestions' aren't enabled.

tabFocusMode.en: Controls whether the editor receives tabs or defers them to the workbench for navigation.

trimWhitespaceOnDelete.en: Controls whether the editor will also delete the next line's indentation whitespace when deleting a newline.

unfoldOnClickAfterEndOfLine.en: Controls whether clicking on the empty content after a folded line will unfold the line.

unicodeHighlight.allowedCharacters.en: Defines allowed characters that are not being highlighted.

unicodeHighlight.allowedLocales.en: Unicode characters that are common in allowed locales are not being highlighted.

unicodeHighlight.ambiguousCharacters.en: Controls whether characters are highlighted that can be confused with basic ASCII characters, except those that are common in the current user locale.

unicodeHighlight.includeComments.en: Controls whether characters in comments should also be subject to Unicode highlighting.

unicodeHighlight.includeStrings.en: Controls whether characters in strings should also be subject to Unicode highlighting.

unicodeHighlight.invisibleCharacters.en: Controls whether characters that just reserve space or have no width at all are highlighted.

unicodeHighlight.nonBasicASCII.en: Controls whether all non-basic ASCII characters are highlighted. Only characters between U+0020 and U+007E, tab, line-feed and carriage-return are considered basic ASCII.

unusualLineTerminators.en: Remove unusual line terminators that might cause problems.

unusualLineTerminators.auto.en: Unusual line terminators are automatically removed.

unusualLineTerminators.prompt.en: Unusual line terminators prompt to be removed.

useTabStops.en: Spaces and tabs are inserted and deleted in alignment with tab stops.

wordBreak.en: Controls the word break rules used for Chinese/Japanese/Korean (CJK) text.

wordBreak.keepAll.en: Word breaks should not be used for Chinese/Japanese/Korean (CJK) text. Non-CJK text behavior is the same as for normal.

wordBreak.normal.en: Use the default line break rule.

wordSegmenterLocales.en: Locales to be used for word segmentation when doing word related navigations or operations. Specify the BCP 47 language tag of the word you wish to recognize (e.g., ja, zh-CN, zh-Hant-TW, etc.).

wordSeparators.en: Characters that will be used as word separators when doing word related navigations or operations.

comment: - 'off', 'on', 'wordWrapColumn' and 'bounded' refer to values the setting can take and should not be localized.
- `editor.wordWrapColumn` refers to a different setting and should not be localized.

wordWrap.bounded.en: Lines will wrap at the minimum of viewport and `#editor.wordWrapColumn#`.
comment: - viewport means the edge of the visible window size.
- `editor.wordWrapColumn` refers to a different setting and should not be localized.

wordWrap.on.en: Lines will wrap at the viewport width.

comment: - `editor.wordWrapColumn` refers to a different setting and should not be localized.

wordWrapColumn.en: Controls the wrapping column of the editor when `#editor.wordWrap#` is `wordWrapColumn` or `bounded`.
comment: - `editor.wordWrap` refers to a different setting and should not be localized.
- 'wordWrapColumn' and 'bounded' refer to values the different setting can take and should not be localized.

wordWrapIndicator.en: Controls whether an indicator is rendered at the wrapping column of lines that wrap. Only has an effect when `#editor.wordWrap#` is enabled.

wrapOnEscapedLineFeeds.en:
Controls whether literal `\n` shall trigger a wordWrap when `#editor.wordWrap#` is enabled.

For example:
```c
char* str="hello\nworld"
```
will be displayed as
```c
char* str="hello\n
           world"
```

wrappingIndent.en: Controls the indentation of wrapped lines.

wrappingIndent.deepIndent.en: Wrapped lines get +2 indentation toward the parent.

wrappingIndent.indent.en: Wrapped lines get +1 indentation toward the parent.

wrappingIndent.none.en: No indentation. Wrapped lines begin at column 1.

wrappingIndent.same.en: Wrapped lines get the same indentation as the parent.

wrappingStrategy.en: Controls the algorithm that computes wrapping points. Note that when in accessibility mode, advanced will be used for the best experience.

wrappingStrategy.advanced.en: Delegates wrapping points computation to the browser. This is a slow algorithm, that might cause freezes for large files, but it works correctly in all cases.

wrappingStrategy.simple.en: Assumes that all characters are of the same width. This is a fast algorithm that works correctly for monospace fonts and certain scripts (like Latin characters) where glyphs are of equal width.

editorActiveIndentGuide.en: Color of the active editor indentation guides.

editorActiveIndentGuide1.en: Color of the active editor indentation guides (1).

editorActiveIndentGuide2.en: Color of the active editor indentation guides (2).

editorActiveIndentGuide3.en: Color of the active editor indentation guides (3).

editorActiveIndentGuide4.en: Color of the active editor indentation guides (4).

editorActiveIndentGuide5.en: Color of the active editor indentation guides (5).

editorActiveIndentGuide6.en: Color of the active editor indentation guides (6).

editorActiveLineNumber.en: Color of editor active line number

editorBracketHighlightForeground1.en: Foreground color of brackets (1). Requires enabling bracket pair colorization.

editorBracketHighlightForeground2.en: Foreground color of brackets (2). Requires enabling bracket pair colorization.

editorBracketHighlightForeground3.en: Foreground color of brackets (3). Requires enabling bracket pair colorization.

editorBracketHighlightForeground4.en: Foreground color of brackets (4). Requires enabling bracket pair colorization.

editorBracketHighlightForeground5.en: Foreground color of brackets (5). Requires enabling bracket pair colorization.

editorBracketHighlightForeground6.en: Foreground color of brackets (6). Requires enabling bracket pair colorization.

editorBracketPairGuide.activeBackground1.en: Background color of active bracket pair guides (1). Requires enabling bracket pair guides.

editorBracketPairGuide.activeBackground2.en: Background color of active bracket pair guides (2). Requires enabling bracket pair guides.

editorBracketPairGuide.activeBackground3.en: Background color of active bracket pair guides (3). Requires enabling bracket pair guides.

editorBracketPairGuide.activeBackground4.en: Background color of active bracket pair guides (4). Requires enabling bracket pair guides.

editorBracketPairGuide.activeBackground5.en: Background color of active bracket pair guides (5). Requires enabling bracket pair guides.

editorBracketPairGuide.activeBackground6.en: Background color of active bracket pair guides (6). Requires enabling bracket pair guides.

editorBracketPairGuide.background1.en: Background color of inactive bracket pair guides (1). Requires enabling bracket pair guides.

editorBracketPairGuide.background2.en: Background color of inactive bracket pair guides (2). Requires enabling bracket pair guides.

editorBracketPairGuide.background3.en: Background color of inactive bracket pair guides (3). Requires enabling bracket pair guides.

editorBracketPairGuide.background4.en: Background color of inactive bracket pair guides (4). Requires enabling bracket pair guides.

editorBracketPairGuide.background5.en: Background color of inactive bracket pair guides (5). Requires enabling bracket pair guides.

editorBracketPairGuide.background6.en: Background color of inactive bracket pair guides (6). Requires enabling bracket pair guides.

editorCursorBackground.en: The background color of the editor cursor. Allows customizing the color of a character overlapped by a block cursor.

editorDimmedLineNumber.en: Color of the final editor line when editor.renderFinalNewline is set to dimmed.

editorGhostTextBackground.en: Background color of the ghost text in the editor.

editorGhostTextBorder.en: Border color of ghost text in the editor.

editorGhostTextForeground.en: Foreground color of the ghost text in the editor.

editorGutter.en: Background color of the editor gutter. The gutter contains the glyph margins and the line numbers.

editorIndentGuides.en: Color of the editor indentation guides.

editorIndentGuides1.en: Color of the editor indentation guides (1).

editorIndentGuides2.en: Color of the editor indentation guides (2).

editorIndentGuides3.en: Color of the editor indentation guides (3).

editorIndentGuides4.en: Color of the editor indentation guides (4).

editorIndentGuides5.en: Color of the editor indentation guides (5).

editorIndentGuides6.en: Color of the editor indentation guides (6).

editorMultiCursorPrimaryBackground.en: The background color of the primary editor cursor when multiple cursors are present. Allows customizing the color of a character overlapped by a block cursor.

editorMultiCursorPrimaryForeground.en: Color of the primary editor cursor when multiple cursors are present.

editorMultiCursorSecondaryBackground.en: The background color of secondary editor cursors when multiple cursors are present. Allows customizing the color of a character overlapped by a block cursor.

editorMultiCursorSecondaryForeground.en: Color of secondary editor cursors when multiple cursors are present.

editorOverviewRulerBackground.en: Background color of the editor overview ruler.

editorOverviewRulerBorder.en: Color of the overview ruler border.

editorUnicodeHighlight.background.en: Background color used to highlight unicode characters.

editorUnicodeHighlight.border.en: Border color used to highlight unicode characters.

editorWhitespaces.en: Color of whitespace characters in the editor.

editorWordWrapIndicator.en: Color of the indicator shown at the end of a soft wrapped line in the editor.

inactiveLineHighlight.en: Background color for the highlight of line at the cursor position when the editor is not focused.

lineHighlight.en: Background color for the highlight of line at the cursor position.

lineHighlightBorderBox.en: Background color for the border around the line at the cursor position.

overviewRuleError.en: Overview ruler marker color for errors.

overviewRuleInfo.en: Overview ruler marker color for infos.

overviewRulerRangeHighlight.en: Overview ruler marker color for range highlights. The color must not be opaque so as not to hide underlying decorations.

overviewRuleWarning.en: Overview ruler marker color for warnings.

rangeHighlight.en: Background color of highlighted ranges, like by quick open and find features. The color must not be opaque so as not to hide underlying decorations.

rangeHighlightBorder.en: Background color of the border around highlighted ranges.

symbolHighlight.en: Background color of highlighted symbol, like for go to definition or go next/previous symbol. The color must not be opaque so as not to hide underlying decorations.

symbolHighlightBorder.en: Background color of the border around highlighted symbols.

unnecessaryCodeBorder.en: Border color of unnecessary (unused) source code in the editor.

unnecessaryCodeOpacity.en: Opacity of unnecessary (unused) source code in the editor. For example, "#000000c0" will render the code with 75% opacity. For high contrast themes, use the  'editorUnnecessaryCode.border' theme color to underline unnecessary code instead of fading it out.

accessibleDiffViewerVisible.en: Whether the accessible diff viewer is visible

comparingMovedCode.en: Whether a moved code block is selected for comparison

diffEditorAutomaticRenderSideBySide.en: Whether automatic diff editor layout would render side by side

diffEditorHasChanges.en: Whether the diff editor has changes

diffEditorModifiedUri.en: The uri of the modified document

diffEditorModifiedWritable.en: Whether modified is writable in the diff editor

diffEditorOriginalUri.en: The uri of the original document

diffEditorOriginalWritable.en: Whether modified is writable in the diff editor

diffEditorRenderSideBySideInlineBreakpoi.en: Whether the diff editor render side by side inline breakpoint is reached

diffEditorTemporaryInlineMode.en: Whether inline mode is temporarily active after manually resizing the diff editor

editorFocus.en: Whether the editor or an editor widget has focus (e.g. focus is in the find widget)

editorHasCodeActionsProvider.en: Whether the editor has a code actions provider

editorHasCodeLensProvider.en: Whether the editor has a code lens provider

editorHasCompletionItemProvider.en: Whether the editor has a completion item provider

editorHasDeclarationProvider.en: Whether the editor has a declaration provider

editorHasDefinitionProvider.en: Whether the editor has a definition provider

editorHasDocumentFormattingProvider.en: Whether the editor has a document formatting provider

editorHasDocumentHighlightProvider.en: Whether the editor has a document highlight provider

editorHasDocumentSelectionFormattingProv.en: Whether the editor has a document selection formatting provider

editorHasDocumentSymbolProvider.en: Whether the editor has a document symbol provider

editorHasHoverProvider.en: Whether the editor has a hover provider

editorHasImplementationProvider.en: Whether the editor has an implementation provider

editorHasInlayHintsProvider.en: Whether the editor has an inline hints provider

editorHasMultipleDocumentFormattingProvi.en: Whether the editor has multiple document formatting providers

editorHasMultipleDocumentSelectionFormat.en: Whether the editor has multiple document selection formatting providers

editorHasMultipleSelections.en: Whether the editor has multiple selections

editorHasReferenceProvider.en: Whether the editor has a reference provider

editorHasRenameProvider.en: Whether the editor has a rename provider

editorHasSelection.en: Whether the editor has text selected

editorHasSignatureHelpProvider.en: Whether the editor has a signature help provider

editorHasTypeDefinitionProvider.en: Whether the editor has a type definition provider

editorHoverFocused.en: Whether the editor hover is focused

editorHoverVisible.en: Whether the editor hover is visible

editorLangId.en: The language identifier of the editor

editorSelectionHasDiagnostics.en: Whether any diagnostic is present in the current editor selection

editorTabMovesFocus.en: Whether `Tab` will move focus out of the editor

editorTextFocus.en: Whether the editor text has focus (cursor is blinking)

inCompositeEditor.en: Whether the editor is part of a larger editor (e.g. notebooks)

inDiffEditor.en: Whether the context is a diff editor

inMultiDiffEditor.en: Whether the context is a multi diff editor

isComposing.en: Whether the editor is in the composition mode

isEmbeddedDiffEditor.en: Whether the context is an embedded diff editor

multiDiffEditorAllCollapsed.en: Whether all files in multi diff editor are collapsed

multiDiffEditorItemAllUnchangedRegionsSh.en: Whether all unchanged regions of a multi diff editor file are revealed

multiDiffEditorRenderSideBySide.en: Whether the multi diff editor renders diffs side by side instead of inline

standaloneColorPickerFocused.en: Whether the standalone color picker is focused

standaloneColorPickerVisible.en: Whether the standalone color picker is visible

stickyScrollFocused.en: Whether the sticky scroll is focused

stickyScrollVisible.en: Whether the sticky scroll is visible

textInputFocus.en: Whether an editor or a rich text input has focus (cursor is blinking)

acceptSuggestAction.en: Accept suggestion{0} to accept the currently selected suggestion.

announceCursorPosition.en: Run the command: Announce Cursor Position{0} to hear the current line and column.

auto_off.en: The application is configured to never be optimized for usage with a Screen Reader.

auto_on.en: The application is configured to be optimized for usage with a Screen Reader.

changeConfigToOnMac.en: Configure the application to be optimized for usage with a Screen Reader (Command+E).

changeConfigToOnWinLinux.en: Configure the application to be optimized for usage with a Screen Reader (Control+E).

chatEditing.navigation.en: Navigate between edits in the editor with navigate previous{0} and next{1} and accept{2}, reject{3} or view the diff{4} for the current change. Accept edits across all files{5}.

chatEditorModification.en: The editor contains pending modifications that have been made by chat.

chatEditorRequestInProgress.en: The editor is currently waiting for modifications to be made by chat.

codeFolding.en: Use code folding to collapse blocks of code and focus on the code you're interested in via the Toggle Folding Command{0}.

debug.startDebugging.en: The Debug: Start Debugging command{0} will start a debug session.

debugConsole.addToWatch.en: The Debug: Add to Watch command{0} will add the selected text to the watch view.

debugConsole.executeSelection.en: The Debug: Execute Selection command{0} will execute the selected text in the debug console.

debugConsole.setBreakpoint.en: The Debug: Inline Breakpoint command{0} will set or unset a breakpoint at the current cursor position in the active editor.

defaultWindowTitleExcludingEditorState.en: activeEditorState - such as modified, problems, and more, is currently not included as a part of the window.title setting by default. Enable it with accessibility.windowTitleOptimized.

defaultWindowTitleIncludesEditorState.en: activeEditorState - such as modified, problems, and more, is included as a part of the window.title setting by default. Disable it with accessibility.windowTitleOptimized.

editableDiffEditor.en: You are in a pane of a diff editor.

editableEditor.en: You are in a code editor.

editorDictation.en: Start or stop dictation in the editor{0}.

agentHost.config.customizations.descript.en: Plugins configured on this agent host and available to remote sessions.

agentHost.config.defaultShell.descriptio.en: Absolute path to the shell executable used by host-managed terminals. Normally pushed by the connected VS Code client from `terminal.integrated.agentHostProfile.<os>` (falling back to `terminal.integrated.defaultProfile.<os>`); when unset, the agent host falls back to the system shell. The workbench only pushes this for the local agent host — remote agent host operators should set this directly in the remote machine's `agent-host-config.json`.

agentHost.config.githubEnterpriseUri.des.en: Optional base URI of a GitHub Enterprise instance (for example "https://ghe.example.com" for GitHub Enterprise Server, or "https://tenant.ghe.com" for GitHub Enterprise Cloud). When set, the agent host authenticates and makes GitHub API calls against this instance instead of github.com. Normally pushed by the connected VS Code client from the selected enterprise account's authorization server; remote agent host operators can set it directly in the remote `agent-host-config.json`.

agentHostEnabled.en: Whether Agent Host features are available and AI features are enabled in this window.

agentHostExistingSessionHarnessPickerEna.en: Whether existing Agent Host sessions in the main VS Code window show the current harness as a disabled picker.

chat.defaultToCopilotHarness.en: When enabled, new editor and panel chat sessions default to the Agent Host Copilot SDK instead of the local harness.

chat.editor.agentHost.existingSessionHar.en: When enabled, existing Agent Host sessions in the main VS Code window show the current harness as a disabled picker.

chat.editor.localAgent.enabled.en: When enabled, shows the VS Code local chat harness in the chat picker. This setting is ignored in virtual workspaces, where the local chat harness is always available.

chat.editor.preferCopilotHarness.en: When enabled, uses the Agent Host Copilot SDK whenever the local harness would otherwise be selected for a new editor chat session. Claude and Codex selections are unaffected.

chat.editor.preferCopilotHarness.policy.en: Configure whether VS Code uses the Agent Host Copilot SDK instead of the local harness for new editor chat sessions.

agentHost.config.byokModelsEnabled.descr.en: Whether extension-provided BYOK models are enabled.

agentHost.config.claudeMultiRootEnabled..en: Whether the Claude provider advertises support for multiple working directories, letting a session span every folder of a multi-root workspace.

agentHost.config.codexAgentEnabled.descr.en: Whether the Codex provider is enabled.

agentHost.config.codexMultiRootEnabled.d.en: Whether the Codex provider advertises support for multiple working directories, letting a session span every folder of a multi-root workspace.

agentHost.config.copilotMultiRootEnabled.en: Whether the Copilot provider advertises support for multiple working directories, letting a session span every folder of a multi-root workspace.

agentHost.config.disableRepoInfoTelemetr.en: Whether repository information telemetry is disabled for Agent Host sessions.

agentHost.config.editAutoApprovePatterns.en: Effective edit auto-approve patterns forwarded by the connected client for agent-host write permission checks.

agentHost.config.githubMcpServerEnabled..en: Whether agent sessions include a GitHub MCP server by default.

chat.agentHost.codexAgent.multiRootEnabl.en: When enabled, Codex agent-host sessions advertise support for multiple working directories, so a session created in a multi-root workspace can span every workspace folder. chat.agentHost.copilotAgent.multiRootEna.en: When enabled, Copilot agent-host sessions advertise support for multiple working directories, so a session created in a multi-root workspace can span every workspace folder. chat.agentHost.otel.otlpEndpoint.policy.en: Controls the enterprise-managed OTLP collector endpoint for Copilot OpenTelemetry export.

chat.agentHost.otel.otlpProtocol.policy.en: Controls the enterprise-managed OTLP wire protocol (protobuf vs JSON) for Copilot OpenTelemetry export.

chat.agentHost.otel.resourceAttributes.p.en: Controls the enterprise-managed OTel resource attributes for Copilot OpenTelemetry export.

chat.agentHost.otel.serviceName.policy.en: Controls the enterprise-managed OTel `service.name` resource attribute for Copilot OpenTelemetry export.

chat.agentHost.systemProxy.enabled.en: When enabled, Copilot sessions automatically discover and use the operating system's proxy configuration when no proxy environment variable is set.

Applied when the session launches or resumes.

Inline YAML that overrides the system prompt and/or SDK tool descriptions for sessions on this model. Takes precedence over `promptOverrideFile`.

sessionsChanges.createPR.en: For Agent Host sessions, Create PR opens a form with generated, editable title and description, a draft checkbox, and merge options. The form appears while generation is in progress and preserves anything you type. Use Tab to navigate and Escape to dismiss while keeping your text. Cancel discards your text.

sessionsChanges.createPR.agentMergeHints.en: Each Agent Merge checkbox has a description explaining what it does and when it acts. Focus a checkbox to hear its description, or hover over the info icon after its label to read it. Press Space to toggle it.

sessionsChanges.createPR.branches.en: The header identifies the repository, followed by the base branch on the left and source branch on the right. The arrow points toward the base branch that will receive the changes.

sessionsChanges.createPR.draft.en: Create as Draft keeps the pull request in draft until it is ready for review.

sessionsChanges.createPR.merge.en: Merge Manually leaves merging to you. Selecting Agent Merge reveals checkboxes for addressing reviews, fixing CI failures, and resolving conflicts or behind branches. Merge Pull Request lets you turn merging off, merge only if Agent Merge made no changes, or merge when ready. Session settings are changed only on submission, not when opening or cancelling the form. Auto-Merge asks GitHub to merge when requirements pass and lets you choose an allowed merge method. GitHub auto-merge is not available for drafts.

sessionsChanges.createPR.navigation.en: Use Tab and Shift+Tab to move between fields and buttons. Use arrow keys to choose a merge option and Space to toggle Create as Draft.

sessionsChanges.createPR.overview.en: You are in the Create Pull Request form. Title and description are generated in the background. Each field shows a loading indicator and reports a busy state until generation finishes. Your remembered options are shown immediately and can be changed while generation is in progress. You may start editing immediately; generated text never replaces your edits.

sessionsChanges.createPR.preferences.en: Draft, merge options, and the last-used submission action are remembered across sessions in this profile, even if you cancel. Title and description are kept in memory when you dismiss and reopen the form for the same session and branches. Cancel discards this content. Unavailable options are not applied, but your preferences are kept for repositories and hosts that support them.

sessionsChanges.createPR.submit.en: Create PR is disabled while details are being generated. It closes the form immediately, then commits and pushes your changes and creates the pull request in the background. When available, Tab to Pull Request Actions and press Enter or Space to open the dropdown. Send Create PR Message is available even during generation. It asks this session's agent to create the pull request with your selected options and generate its own title and description, without using the form's text. The last-used action becomes the primary button. Control+Enter on Windows and Linux, or Command+Enter on macOS, runs that primary action. Press Escape to dismiss the dropdown, or Escape in the form to close without submitting and keep your text. Cancel closes the form and discards your text.

sessionsChat.aquariumAction.en: To show or hide the aquarium action on the new-session view, use the checked Aquarium item in the context menu outside the composer, or run the Toggle Aquarium Action Visibility command.

sessionsChat.archiveChat.en: To archive an individual nested chat without archiving its session, open the chat's context menu in the Sessions list or chat tab and choose Archive. The chat is hidden from the Sessions list and closed, but is not deleted. Open the Sessions list Filter menu and enable Archived to show it again, then open the chat's context menu and choose Unarchive.

sessionsChat.archiveNudge.en: When all GitHub pull requests associated with the session have merged and no chat is working or waiting for input, an archive suggestion may appear above the chat input. Use Tab or Shift+Tab to reach Archive, Configure Automatic Cleanup, or Dismiss Archive Suggestion, then Enter or Space to activate it. Configure Automatic Cleanup opens the settings for automatically archiving inactive merged sessions and permanently deleting automatically archived merged sessions. The explanation under What Does "Archive" Do? is collapsed by default. Use Tab to reach it and Enter or Space to expand or collapse it. Dismiss Archive Suggestion, or Escape while the suggestion is focused, hides the suggestion for this session, including after a reload, until it is archived or deleted, and returns focus to the chat input. Archiving the session hides it from the sessions list so you can focus on your remaining tasks. The session is not deleted. Ask your agent to find it, or look in the "Archived" section of the sessions list. You can unarchive it anytime. The worktree created for the session, if any, will be deleted. You can recreate it by unarchiving the session.

sessionsChat.archiveNudgeOnboarding.en: The first time you activate the suggestion's Archive or Mark as Done button, a spotlight may reveal that session's action in the sessions list. It briefly waits for the list action to appear. The action waits until you activate the highlighted action, activate Understood, or press Escape to end the spotlight. Use Tab or Shift+Tab to move between the highlighted action and Understood, and Enter or Space to activate either. If the spotlight cannot be shown or is interrupted, the session is still archived or marked as done as long as the suggestion remains available. Once completed or skipped, the spotlight will not appear again.

sessionsChat.archiveSession.en: To archive or mark one or more sessions as done, focus them in the Sessions list and invoke Archive or Mark as Done{0}.

sessionsChat.background.en: Outside high contrast themes, use Set Background to choose no background, the built-in theme-aware Codicons pattern, a new image, or one of the five most recently selected images. One randomly selected icon in the Codicons pattern is a Celebrate button; press Tab to find it, then press Enter or Space to activate it. Each activation selects another random icon as the next Celebrate button. Use Change Background Layout to choose whether an image repeats, stretches, or appears at an edge or corner for the current color theme. Moving through the layout picker previews each option; select one to save it, or press Escape to restore the previous layout. Both commands are available from the Command Palette and by right-clicking empty chat space. Change Background Layout is shown only for images. Background customization is unavailable while a high contrast theme is active.

sessionsChat.backgroundActivities.en: Press Shift+Tab from the chat input to reach metadata and status pills above it, use the left and right arrows to move between pills, and press Enter or Space to activate one. Live browsers appear in their own pill, and the chat's subagents appear in another. A pill with more than one entry opens a picker. Subagents are grouped under Subagents: In Progress and Subagents: Completed. In Progress includes subagents waiting for input; Completed includes failed subagents. Use the up and down arrows to move between entries. When an entry has details, Tab moves through its row actions and detail links; Shift+Tab returns to the row action, and the up and down arrows continue moving between entries. Press Enter to open an entry, or Escape to dismiss the picker and return focus to the pill.

sessionsChat.backgroundTint.en: When a background image is set, use Tint Window to Match Background in the Command Palette or the background context menu to turn matching window colors on or off. A check mark means tinting is enabled. Turning it off keeps the background image and restores the original window colors.

sessionsChat.branchPickerUpstream.en: For a new Agent Host session in a Git repository, use Tab to reach the branch picker and press Enter or Space to choose a base branch. With New Worktree checked, the current branch's tracked upstream is selected by default when available; otherwise the default branch is selected. When either the current branch or its upstream is selected, both appear together at the top with the upstream first and focused when the picker opens. Use the arrow keys to choose a branch and press Enter to select it.

sessionsChat.chatGroups.en: Chats can be arranged in groups. Focus the previous group{0} or next group{1}. Split the active chat into a group to the right{2} or below{3}, or move it to the previous group{4} or next group{5}.

sessionsChat.closeChat.en: Activate a chat tab's close button to close (hide) that chat from the tab strip without deleting it; reopen it later from the Chats menu. The session's main chat cannot be closed.

sessionsChat.compactArchiveNudge.en: After you successfully use the suggestion to archive or mark a session as done three times, future suggestions appear in a compact layout without the explanation. The buttons wrap below the title when space is limited, while Dismiss stays at the top right. The keyboard order is Archive or Mark as Done, Configure, then Dismiss. Configure opens the same automatic cleanup settings.

sessionsChat.connectionLog.en: While connecting to a Dev Container for an existing session, use Tab to reach Show Log and press Enter to open the Dev Container output channel.

sessionsChat.contextReferences.en: Type # in the chat input to attach context. Use #file to reference a file or folder, or #session to reference another agent session. Referencing a session together with the /troubleshoot command analyzes that session's logs instead of the current one. Accept a suggestion with Tab or Enter. Openable references appear as buttons above the input; activate one to open it, or use its Remove button to detach it.

sessionsChat.conversationsAsSessionView.en: Chats open directly in the session view without a tab row. Side-by-side chats each show a session header. Pin keeps that chat visible when another chat opens. Close removes that chat group. Closing the last group closes the session from the grid. Non-main chats are hidden and can be reopened later. For sessions that support multiple chats, use Show Chat Tabs in the session overflow menu to show multiple tabs.

sessionsChat.conversationsAsTabs.en: When multiple chats appear as tabs in a single group, the tab row replaces the session header and includes the session actions. Side-by-side chat groups retain the session header and keep their tab rows compact. For sessions that support multiple chats, use Show Chat Tabs in the session overflow menu to show a single chat.

sessionsChat.copySessionLink.en: To copy a browser link that opens an Agent Host session in the Agents window, open the session's context menu and choose Copy Link.

sessionsChat.createdBySession.en: When a session was created by another session, focus it in the Sessions list and use the Show Hover command{0}. Move focus to the Created by link, then press Enter or Space to open the creator session.

sessionsChat.customizations.en: Focus Chat Customizations in the left sidebar{0}.

sessionsChat.delegatedMessage.en: Messages sent by another session or chat show a source annotation above the message. Press Tab to focus the annotation, then press Enter or Space to open the source chat.

sessionsChat.deleteChat.en: To permanently delete a chat, open the chat tab's context menu and choose Delete Chat. This is destructive and cannot be undone.

sessionsChat.deleteSession.en: To permanently delete a session, open its context menu and choose Delete. This is destructive and cannot be undone.

sessionsChat.devContainer.en: When Dev Container Agent Host sessions are enabled, Docker is available on the host, and a local, SSH, Tunnel, or WSL folder contains a Dev Container configuration, open the folder's submenu and choose Use Dev Container. For remote folders, first connect to a host that supports Dev Container sessions. For WSL folders, Docker must be available in the WSL distribution. Use the arrow keys to navigate submenus and Enter to select. The workspace picker then identifies the folder with a Dev Container suffix. Choose Use Local or Use Remote Host to switch back.

sessionsChat.dictation.en: When dictation is configured, dictate your message into the input{0}. Tap to start and stop, or hold to dictate only while pressed. If the speech-to-text model is still preparing, activate the dictation control again to cancel.

sessionsChat.doneChat.en: To mark an individual nested chat as done without marking its session as done, open the chat's context menu in the Sessions list or chat tab and choose Mark as Done. The chat is hidden from the Sessions list and closed, but is not deleted. Open the Sessions list Filter menu and enable Done to show it again, then open the chat's context menu and choose Restore.

sessionsChat.doneNudge.en: When all GitHub pull requests associated with the session have merged and no chat is working or waiting for input, a mark as done suggestion may appear above the chat input. Use Tab or Shift+Tab to reach Mark as Done, Configure Automatic Cleanup, or Dismiss Mark as Done Suggestion, then Enter or Space to activate it. Configure Automatic Cleanup opens the settings for automatically archiving inactive merged sessions and permanently deleting automatically archived merged sessions. The explanation under What Does "Mark as Done" Do? is collapsed by default. Use Tab to reach it and Enter or Space to expand or collapse it. Dismiss Mark as Done Suggestion, or Escape while the suggestion is focused, hides the suggestion for this session, including after a reload, until it is marked as done or deleted, and returns focus to the chat input. Marking the session as done hides it from the sessions list so you can focus on your remaining tasks. The session is not deleted. Ask your agent to find it, or look in the "Done" section of the sessions list. You can restore it anytime. The worktree created for the session, if any, will be deleted. You can recreate it by restoring the session.

sessionsChat.externalSessionAdoption.en: Once you send a message to an external session's agent, it becomes a regular session. Its banner and External hover label disappear, and it is no longer grouped or filtered as external.

sessionsChat.externalSessionBanner.en: When you first open a session created in another application, a banner appears at the top of the chat. Use Tab to reach its external-session picker, choose an option, and activate Save. The Close action dismisses the banner without changing the setting. Saving or closing permanently dismisses the banner.

sessionsChat.externalSessionFilter.en: The Sessions list Filter menu includes an External submenu. Choose None, Recent, Last 24 Hours, Last 7 Days, or Last 30 Days to control which sessions from other applications are shown.

sessionsChat.externalSessionImport.en: To make an external session a regular session without sending a message, use Import in its row toolbar, before Archive or Mark as Done, or focus the session and choose Import from its context menu{0}. This action is available when the host supports importing sessions.

sessionsChat.externalSessionSectionArchi.en: External sessions appear in an External section above Archived unless they are pinned or in a custom group. The section is hidden when empty. Focus its heading and open the context menu{0} to configure which external sessions are shown or archive the section's sessions.

sessionsChat.externalSessionSectionDone.en: External sessions appear in an External section above Done unless they are pinned or in a custom group. The section is hidden when empty. Focus its heading and open the context menu{0} to configure which external sessions are shown or mark the section's sessions as done.

sessionsChat.failingChecksPullRequest.en: When a session pull request has failing checks, use Reveal in its banner item to open that pull request, or use Fix Checks to ask the agent to address the failures.

sessionsChat.feedbackAttachment.en: When a feedback comments attachment appears above the input, focus it and press Enter or Space. A single comment opens directly. Multiple comments open a tree grouped by file; use the arrow keys to navigate, Enter to reveal a comment, and Escape to close the tree.

sessionsChat.feedbackComments.en: When pull requests have failing checks or unreviewed comments, one banner appears above the input. If several pull requests need attention, use the Previous Banner and Next Banner buttons to move between them. A pull request with both failing checks and comments uses a split button: activate the main action to address both, or use its More Actions button to address only the checks or comments. In-product agent review comments appear as their own carousel item.

sessionsChat.find.en: To search the chat transcript, invoke Find in Chat{0}. Find Next{1} and Find Previous{2} move between results, scrolling each one into view.

sessionsChat.focusActiveSession.en: Focus the active session{0}. The default Open Chat (Agent) shortcut also focuses the active session in the Agents window.

sessionsChat.forkToSide.en: Alt-click, or Option-click on macOS, the Fork Conversation button at a checkpoint to open the fork beside its source. Ordinary activation keeps its existing behavior. With the keyboard, activate Fork Conversation, reopen the source from the Sessions list, then choose Open to the Side from the fork's context menu.

sessionsChat.githubContext.en: Use Add Context to attach files, images, and, when available, GitHub issues or pull requests.

sessionsChat.githubReferences.en: Pull request and issue pills above the chat input open their GitHub item in the GitHub Pull Requests extension when it is available. Pills that represent several items open a keyboard-accessible picker.

sessionsChat.harnessSwitchFeedbackSurvey.en: After you switch from Copilot to Local, a two-step feedback survey may appear above the chat input. Use Shift+Tab to reach it. In the first step, use Up and Down Arrow to choose why you switched, then press Enter or Space. In the second step, enter any optional feedback and use Tab to reach Submit. Dismiss Survey or Escape closes the survey. After submission, the questions are replaced above the input by a message that your feedback was recorded. Use Dismiss Feedback Acknowledgement or Escape to close it.

sessionsChat.history.en: Use up and down arrows to navigate your request history in the input box.

sessionsChat.input.en: You are in the chat input. Type a message and press Enter to send it.

sessionsChat.inputBackground.en: Press Alt+Enter to start the session in the background without navigating into it. The started session appears in the Chat Sessions view.

sessionsChat.inputPills.en: When session metadata or active-turn status pills appear above the input, press Shift+Tab to reach them, use the Left and Right arrow keys to move between them, and press Enter or Space to activate one. Open the context menu{0} to choose which pills are shown. Pull Requests Options lets you show all pull requests or only open and draft ones. Subagent Options offers Show All and Show In Progress. These choices are remembered across sessions. If every entry of a pill is filtered out, its options are also available in any other pill's context menu or the toolbar context menu.

sessionsChat.mainChatToSide.en: To open the main chat beside a peer chat, choose Open to the Side from the session row's context menu. You can also Alt-click (Option-click on macOS) the row or drag it to a chat pane's edge.

sessionsChat.micContextMenu.en: To choose a microphone or turn off dictation or Voice Mode, focus the microphone button in the input toolbar and open its context menu (for example Shift+F10).

sessionsChat.migrations.en: When agent customizations need an update, a notice below the new-session input shows how many need attention. Use Tab to reach Review Migrations and open the Migrations page. Dismiss Migration Notice for This Workspace hides the notice for that workspace, including after restarting, and returns focus to the input.

sessionsChat.mobileConfig.en: On mobile, the mode and model pickers appear as tappable chips below the input. Tap a chip to open a bottom sheet where you can change the selection.

sessionsChat.navigateChatTabs.en: When a chat tab is focused, use the left and right arrow keys to move to and activate an adjacent chat tab, or Home and End to activate the first and last tabs. Tabs that do not fit are scrolled into view when activated. You can also scroll the tab row with the mouse wheel or drag the horizontal scrollbar that appears when hovering over overflowing tabs.

sessionsChat.navigateNextSession.en: Navigate to the next session in the list{0}.

sessionsChat.navigatePreviousSession.en: Navigate to the previous session in the list{0}.

sessionsChat.newSessionPickers.en: In a new-session composer, open and focus the workspace picker{0} or the harness picker{1}. Focus either picker control and open its context menu{2} to configure its keybinding.

sessionsChat.openPullRequest.en: When the session is associated with GitHub pull requests, a status pill above the chat input shows the pull request number or count. Activate it to open a single pull request or choose from the associated pull requests{0}.

sessionsChat.overview.en: You are in the Agents window. The Agents window is a dedicated workspace for working with AI agents. It provides a chat interface, a changes view for reviewing agent-generated changes, a file explorer, and customization options.

sessionsChat.pasteAsText.en: To paste the clipboard as plain text, without converting it to Markdown or storing it as an attachment, invoke Paste as Text{0}.

sessionsChat.pastedText.en: Long pasted text is stored as an attached text item and replaced in the input with a numbered inline reference.

sessionsChat.pickFolderQuickPick.en: To choose a folder from a searchable list instead, use the New Session in Folder command{0}.

sessionsChat.preparation.en: While a new session is being prepared, the transcript shows your submitted prompt and attachments followed by startup progress. Use Tab to reach Show Log beside the progress message and press Enter to open the Dev Container output channel. The chat input and attachment controls are disabled until preparation finishes. Use the input's Stop action or Cancel Chat command{0} to cancel preparation. If preparation fails or is canceled, your original prompt and attachments remain in the new-session composer.

sessionsChat.promptOptions.en: When prompt options appear above the new-session input, use Tab and Shift+Tab to move between them, then press Enter or Space to insert one. You can select a different option while the input is empty, exactly matches the inserted prompt, or only has its editable placeholder removed; other edits disable the options without hiding them. Clearing the input also clears the selected option. Use the Close action to hide the options and return focus to the input.

sessionsChat.promptTemplatePlaceholder.en: When the new-session prompt contains a highlighted task placeholder, place the caret inside it and replace it{0} to type your task.

sessionsChat.promptTimeline.en: When the prompt timeline is enabled, a handle on the left edge of the transcript lists your prompts. Activate it to expand the list, use the up and down arrows (or Home and End) to move between prompts, Enter or Space to jump to a prompt, and Escape to dismiss the list and return focus to the handle. When a prompt title is pinned above the transcript, activate its title to jump to that prompt.

sessionsChat.pullRequestSession.en: In a repository section where New Session is a split button, focus New Session and press Right Arrow to reach its dropdown, then activate New Session from Pull Request to open a searchable pull request picker. Pull requests are grouped by review and assignment status. Use the arrow keys to navigate, Enter to create the session, and Escape to close the picker.

sessionsChat.quickChat.en: To start a workspace-less quick chat, use the New Quick Chat command{0} or the plus button on the Chats section in the sessions list. When consolidated remote workspaces are enabled, this opens the new-session composer, where you can choose No workspace. Otherwise, it starts a workspace-less chat directly. The Toggle Side Panel command is disabled for quick chats.

sessionsChat.remoteDelegation.en: Ask the agent to list remote agent hosts or create a remote session with platform and resource requirements. Creation uses the standard tool confirmation and does not change the focused chat. The result includes a link to the remote session. Remote sessions can send messages back to the originating chat while this Agents window remains connected.

sessionsChat.remoteInspection.en: Ask the agent to inspect a remote session using its session link. Inspection reads its current state and latest response or error without changing focus, marking the chat as read, or approving pending requests. If the host is unavailable, the result explains why; inspection does not reconnect it.

sessionsChat.removeSessionRecord.en: Recorded artifacts and references offer Remove from Session for each row. Use Tab to reach row actions. When only one item is visible, use its pill hover actions or context menu instead. Removal waits for persistence and only deletes the session record; it does not delete the linked resource, close a pull request or issue, or remove independent session associations.

sessionsChat.renameChat.en: When Rename is available for a non-main chat, focus its tab or nested row in the Sessions list and invoke Rename{0}, or double-click its title, to rename it inline. Type the new title, then press Enter to confirm or Escape to cancel. From the chat transcript or input, invoking Rename opens a prompt instead.

sessionsChat.renameSession.en: To rename a session inline, focus its row in the Sessions list and invoke Rename{0}, double-click its title, or open its context menu and choose Rename. Type the new title, then press Enter to confirm or Escape to cancel. From the main chat transcript or input, invoking Rename edits the header title inline when it is visible and opens a prompt otherwise.

sessionsChat.repositoryCreation.en: This host creates a new environment for each session. Open Select Repository to choose its repository. Selecting a repository does not start an environment; sending your first message does. The harness label identifies the available agent, and Agent Default means the host chooses the model.

sessionsChat.repositorySelection.en: When choosing a GitHub repository in the browser, search or enter a GitHub URL or owner/repository. Use the arrow keys to navigate results, Enter to select, and Escape to cancel. Sign in to GitHub if prompted.

sessionsChat.responseSelectionInput.en: When you select assistant response text, an Ask Question input appears. Type a side question and press Enter to send it, press Shift+Enter to insert a new line, or press Escape to dismiss the input.

sessionsChat.responseSelectionMenu.en: When you select assistant response text, an action menu appears. Press Tab to focus the menu, use the Up Arrow and Down Arrow keys to move between actions, and press Enter to activate one. Press Escape to dismiss the menu. Ask in a Side Chat opens a question input anchored to the selected text. Quote appends the selection as a blockquote in the chat input when the conversation is interactive. Copy copies the selected text.

sessionsChat.sessionsListChatContextMenu.en: Open a nested chat's context menu to rename it, open it to the side, or, when supported, permanently delete it. Agent Host chats also offer Copy Link.

sessionsChat.sessionsListChatsAsSessionV.en: Sessions with multiple user-facing chats show those chats nested beneath the session in the Sessions list. Use the arrow keys to navigate the list and Enter to show a chat as the session view. Side chats and subagent chats are omitted from this nested list: side chats are reachable from the Side Chats dropdown in the session's overflow menu, and subagent chats open from their pills in the chat transcript.

sessionsChat.sessionsListChatsAsTabs.en: Sessions with multiple user-facing chats show those chats nested beneath the session in the Sessions list. Use the arrow keys to navigate the list and Enter to open a chat as a tab. Side chats and subagent chats are omitted from this nested list: side chats are reachable from the Side Chats dropdown in the session's overflow menu, and subagent chats open from their pills in the chat transcript.

sessionsChat.sessionsListDefaultArchiveA.en: The session row toolbar offers Pin or Unpin before Archive. For sessions that support multiple chats, open the session's context menu to start a new chat.

sessionsChat.sessionsListDefaultDoneActi.en: The session row toolbar offers Pin or Unpin before Mark as Done. For sessions that support multiple chats, open the session's context menu to start a new chat.

sessionsChat.sessionsListPromotedNewChat.en: For sessions that support multiple chats, the session row toolbar offers New Chat in This Session before Archive. Open the session's context menu to pin or unpin it.
For sessions that support multiple chats, the session row toolbar offers New Chat in This Session before Mark as Done. Open the session's context menu to pin or unpin it.

sessionsChat.showArchivedChats.en: Use Archived in the Sessions list Filter menu to control whether archived sessions and nested chats are shown. A check mark means archived content is shown.

sessionsChat.showDoneChats.en: Use Done in the Sessions list Filter menu to control whether done sessions and nested chats are shown. A check mark means done content is shown.

sessionsChat.subagentPills.en: Activate a subagent pill in the chat transcript to open the subagent beside the current chat. With the keyboard, focus a pill and press Enter or Space; Alt+Enter also opens it to the side. You can also drag a pill to a chat group's edge to choose where it opens.

sessionsChat.syncChanges.en: When available for a folder session with incoming or outgoing commits, Sync Changes appears with the commit counts in the same repository toolbar as the worktree and branch controls below the input. It is hidden when New Worktree is selected. Use Tab and the arrow keys to reach it, then Enter or Space to synchronize the session's repository. The action is disabled while synchronization is running.

sessionsChat.toggleSidePanel.en: Toggle the side panel (the editor area together with the auxiliary bar) open or closed{0}.

sessionsChat.viewAllChanges.en: Status pills above the chat input include the session's diff stats (lines added and removed). Activate the Changes pill to open the multi-file diff editor with Session Changes for a folder session or Branch Changes for a worktree session{0}.

sessionsChat.voiceMode.en: Start or stop Voice Mode to interact with the agent using your microphone{0}.

sessionsChat.vscodePet.en: Use the checked Pet item in the new-session view context menu, or type /vscode-pet, to show or hide the VS Code pet above the input. Drag it horizontally to reposition it, or use Tab to focus it and the left and right arrow keys to move it. Press Enter or Space to show it some love.

sessionsChat.vscodePetAchievements.en: When the pet is enabled, the user account menu lists unlocked achievement badges before locked badges and provides a View Achievements button. A gold star on the pet announces a newly unlocked achievement; activate the pet while the star is visible to open Achievements.

sessionsChat.welcomeName.en: In a new session, the welcome heading is announced when shown. To disable this announcement, set accessibility.verbosity.newSessionWelcome to false. automationsCustomView.help.authority.en: Automations run on their selected Agent Host, not in this window. Creation and changes require a connected Agent Host that supports automations. Run now requests execution from that host; a disconnected or unsupported host never falls back to local execution. To use another host, duplicate the automation. The original history stays with its host, and an enabled original keeps scheduling until you disable it.

The Built-in Templates section is expanded by default while there are no saved automations. Tab to a template and press Enter or Space to open a New automation dialog with an editable name, prompt, and schedule.

automationsCustomView.help.cards.en: For saved automations, Tab to a card's Edit control and action buttons. Use Left Arrow and Right Arrow to move between Run now and Delete. Press Enter or Space to activate a control. Edit, or clicking anywhere else on the card, opens the automation dialog. Open a card's context menu{0} (for example Shift+F10). Duplicate opens a prefilled New automation dialog, Disable prevents scheduled runs, and Delete asks for confirmation. Run now starts a session immediately.

automationsCustomView.help.dialog.en: In the automation dialog, Target controls are above the prompt. Agent and model pickers are inside the prompt input, and execution mode and permission controls are below it. Use Tab and Shift+Tab to move between fields and pickers. When creating an automation, you only need to enter a prompt. An empty name is derived from the prompt, and the target defaults to No workspace unless one is already supplied. An available Agent Host that supports the target is still required.

automationsCustomView.help.history.en: Run history is grouped by date. While a run is waiting for its session, a lightweight row shows the automation name with a Working... description. Once the session is available, use Up Arrow and Down Arrow to navigate the Sessions list, Enter to open, and Tab to reach Stop, the configured Archive or Mark as Done action, or Delete when available. Open a row's context menu, for example with Shift+F10, to rename it, change its active or read state, or delete it. Delete permanently deletes the session and removes it from run history after confirmation.

automationTemplate.findBugs.description.en: Explore the codebase and report verified, reproducible bugs.

automationTemplate.findBugs.prompt.en:
Explore this codebase and find concrete, reproducible bugs.

Read the repository guidance and understand the architecture before choosing a focused area to investigate, such as recent changes, complex state transitions, or error handling. Trace suspected problems through callers and existing tests. Use the smallest relevant tests or a minimal reproduction to verify behavior, and distinguish confirmed bugs from hypotheses. Avoid style-only suggestions and speculative findings.

Report high-confidence, actionable bugs with severity, file and line references, a triggering scenario, expected versus actual behavior, and supporting test or reproduction results. Suggest a focused fix for each finding without modifying repository files or committing changes. State what you explored, any validation limitations, and when no confirmed bugs were found.

automationTemplate.issueTriage.descripti.en: Triage my GitHub repositories' issues using their precedents.

automationTemplate.issueTriage.prompt.en:
Triage my GitHub repositories' issues using existing repository precedents.

Use the authenticated GitHub account to find my repositories, prioritizing active repositories and new or untriaged issues. For each repository, read its contribution guidelines, issue templates, existing labels, and comparable issues with maintainer decisions. Learn each repository's conventions separately before making recommendations.

Produce a report grouped by repository. Link to each issue, recommend existing labels, identify likely duplicates, and draft a reply when useful. Cite prior issues, pull requests, or maintainer comments supporting each recommendation. Flag uncertainty or missing precedent rather than inventing a rule. Do not apply labels, post comments, close issues, or make other GitHub changes. State which repositories and issues were reviewed and any access limitations.

automationTemplate.mainUpdates.descripti.en: Pull the latest main and summarize new commits.

automationTemplate.mainUpdates.prompt.en:
Pull the latest main and summarize the commits that were pulled.

Inspect this repository's current branch, working tree, and configured remotes. Resolve the remote for main from the repository configuration rather than assuming origin. Record HEAD, then pull that remote's main into the current checkout using --ff-only. Proceed only with a clean working tree and a fast-forward update. If the remote is ambiguous, main is missing, or the update is blocked, stop and explain why. Do not switch branches, stash or discard local changes, rebase, or force an update.

Compare the starting and ending HEAD and summarize only newly pulled commits, grouped by theme. Highlight user-visible changes, bug fixes, breaking changes, and follow-up actions. Include commit links and related pull requests when available. If no commits were pulled, say so.

managedSettingsPrecedence.en: Precedence is native MDM, then server, then file. Most settings resolve per key, filling gaps from lower channels. Telemetry selects one whole block: omitted leaves never inherit from weaker blocks. Empty or unknown-only server/file objects still select a block; native MDM exposes only declared flat keys.
